meta.title: AI Lab
meta.description: Try Local Host's AI experiments, built with Claude by Anthropic: a trip designer with voice, photo matching, agency proposals, answers from our policies, inbox triage for our team and a connector for your own AI assistant.

hero.title: Local Host *AI Lab*
hero.lead: Six working experiments in AI-assisted hospitality — and every answer ends with a real person in Tbilisi.
hero.note: Experimental. Answers are drafts — our team confirms every detail.

teaser.title: Draft a journey *out loud.*
teaser.intro: Our flagship lives on the home page. Pick countries and interests, write — or say — a line, and watch a day-by-day draft appear on the map.
points: A day-by-day draft, streamed in your language
Speak your wishes, and hear the plan read back
Send the draft to our team in one click
teaser.mapCaption: A sample route — Kazbegi, Ananuri, Mtskheta, Tbilisi, Sighnaghi and Telavi.
teaser.voiceNote: Voice works in browsers with speech support; your browser's speech service processes it.

how.title: Clever drafts, *human answers.*

items.title: Claude by Anthropic
items.text: Every experiment runs on Claude, Anthropic's AI model, grounded in Local Host's own experiences, places and policies.

items.title: What is sent
items.text: Only what you type, the photo you choose or the email you paste. It goes to Anthropic to write the answer; this site does not keep it.

items.title: No prices, no bookings
items.text: The AI never quotes prices, holds rooms or books anything. Prices and availability always come from our team.

items.title: Our team confirms
items.text: Every answer is a draft. A person at Local Host in Tbilisi checks each detail before anything is agreed.

how.contact: Questions about the AI Lab? Write to us at

errors.network: We couldn't reach the AI service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: That was a lot of requests in a short time. You can try again in {time}.
errors.dailyCap: The AI Lab has reached today's limit. Please try again tomorrow — or write to info@localhost.ge.
errors.refusal: The AI couldn't help with this one. Try rephrasing it, or write to our team at info@localhost.ge.
errors.truncated: The answer grew too long and was cut short. Try a simpler request.
errors.timeout: This took too long. Please try a shorter request.
errors.busy: The AI service is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.tooLarge: That is too large to send. Try something shorter or smaller.
errors.badRequest: Something in the request isn't right. Please check the form.
errors.unauthorized: This tool needs the staff access key.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
